newsitem.title: MEXICO: REASEARCH ALERT-IPC year-end target raised.
newsitem.headline: REASEARCH ALERT-IPC year-end target raised.

text.p: The Interacciones brokerage has raised its year-end target for Mexico's leading share IPC index to 5,200 points from 4,950.

-- Analyst Carlos Fritsch said in a research report dated July 22 said the upgrade was due to "reduced political risk, better currency predictability, improved conditions in the banking industry and the prospect of stronger flows of funds into Mexico."
-- "Despite the recent rally, the Bolsa remains attractively valued relative to its three-year anticipated cash earnings growth rate and relative to the S&P on a risk-adjusted basis," Fritsch wrote.
The IPC was up 60.80 points on the day, or 1.28 percent, at 6,802.92 at mid-session on Thursday.
